description: Known answers for the rustc / cargo and clippy sanity checks (tools/toolchain.lock.md section 1.1; CM plan section 9.2 table; TV due PDR). kat-target is a dependency-free no_std, no_main image for thumbv8m.main-none-eabihf with its own linker script (vector table, pico-sdk binary-info header with the program name 'cwht-kat-fixture', RP2350 IMAGE_DEF block); it is also the picotool fixture image (tools/tests/fixtures/picotool/). kat-host is a host library with three passing tests whose [lints] tables and clippy.toml are copies of the project lint configuration (firmware/Cargo.toml [workspace.lints] and firmware/clippy.toml, 07 Annex B); features seed faults. Every check runs on a temporary copy with CARGO_TARGET_DIR outside the repository and the toolchain named explicitly (+stable), whose rustc must equal the lock's rustc row; firmware/rust-toolchain.toml pins 1.98.0, which is the same compiler as stable today (lock section 1.3).

target_build.elf_class: ELF32 little-endian, e_machine 40 (ARM), e_entry = address of symbol reset with the Thumb bit set
target_build.reproducibility: SHA-256 of build 1, of build 2 after cargo clean in the same directory, and of build 3 in a second temporary directory are identical (the release profile keeps no debug information, so no build path enters the image)
target_build.elf_sha256_note: regression value, recorded from the first recorded run (2026-09-25); a change of this value with an unchanged fixture and toolchain is a finding

seeded_unwrap.group: restriction (allow by default; denied only by the project lint table)
